meta.name: opportunity-solution-tree
meta.description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree (OST) to structure product discovery — map a desired outcome to opportunities, solutions, and experiments. Based on Teresa Torres' Continuous Discovery Habits. Use when structuring discovery work, mapping opportunities to solutions, or deciding what to build next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用机会解决方案树梳理产品发现过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做产品发现，需要系统化地连接目标、机会和解决方案。
copy.tagline_en: Structure product discovery with an Opportunity Solution Tree
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing product discovery and need to systematically connect outcomes, opportunities, and solutions.

howto.what: 帮你构建机会解决方案树，将期望成果拆解为客户机会、解决方案和实验，从而结构化产品发现过程。
howto.when: 当你需要梳理产品发现工作、将客户问题映射到解决方案，或决定下一步构建什么时触发。

say.text: 帮我为提升7日留存率构建一个机会解决方案树。
say.note: Claude会引导你定义成果、机会、方案和实验。

say.text: 根据这些用户访谈，列出3个关键机会并排序。
say.note: Claude会从访谈中提取客户痛点并计算机会分数。

howto.what_en: Helps you build an Opportunity Solution Tree, breaking down a desired outcome into customer opportunities, solutions, and experiments to structure product discovery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to structure discovery work, map opportunities to solutions, or decide what to build next.

say_en.text: Help me build an opportunity solution tree to increase 7-day retention.
From these user interviews, list 3 key opportunities and prioritize them.
say_en.note: Claude extracts pain points and calculates opportunity scores.
